title: Notifications: what the tile becomes at each size
question: Each size gets a designed layout instead of being refused. Which layouts should Notifications offer? Good alternatives stay selectable in the tile's settings; you pick defaults per size.

options.label: Newest in full
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The newest notice with its first lines, the count above it: reads like a noticeboard pinned to Home.
options.viewport: Notifications at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Unread dots
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The three newest titles with an unread dot each; tall tiles show more.
options.viewport: Notifications at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Count and newest
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The bell, "3 unread" and the newest title: the earlier Hub's tile; all caught up when nothing waits.
